newsitem.title: PAPUA NEW GUINEA: RTRS-Highlands again rejects Placer bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands again rejects Placer bid.

text.p: Papua New Guinea gold miner Highlands Gold Ltd said on Friday that shareholders should not take any action in response to the hostile bid by Placer Dome Inc, which it described as inadequate and significantly undervaluing the company's longer term potential.
Placer Dome has bid 75 Australian cents per share for Highlands, which has a 25 percent stake in the giant Porgera gold mine. Placer has a similar size stake in the mine and is the operator.

Highlands chairman Clive Hildebrand said the company's formal response to the bid would be issued in the first week of January along with an independent report on the company by Barings Brothers Burrows.
"In the meantime shareholders are advised to take no action and to ignore any documents which may be issued by Placer," he said.
Placer has 33 percent of Highlands. Its bid closes on Janaury 18 next year.
Highlands shares ended steady at 75 cents, with a day's high of 76 cents.
